schema1.description: Representation of Wilma stub configuration possibilities

groupName.description: The name of the Stub Configuration, if it is missing, the name will be considered as: 'Default'

active.description: Whether the Stub Configuration is active or not, by default: true

uniqueNameDefinition.description: Object that hold a name of the object, and in the case object is in an array, its name is unique

commentDefinition.description: Object that hold an optional comment text

parameterDefinition.description: Parameter list of a specific object (like: interceptor, condition descriptor etc).

items.description: Every parameter in the list has a name-value string pair.

conditionSetInvokerDefinition.description: Object that holds a condition set invoker

conditionDefinition.description: Describes a single condition that should be evaluated, its result is a boolean value

logicalConditionDefinition.description: Logical evaluation on condition(s), like 'and', 'or', and 'not'

conditionDescriptorDefinition.description: Describes a complex condition which should be evaluated by the switch engine

templateDefinition.description: Describes a single response message template

type.description: Type of the resource. In case of text, it is embedded (resource contains the value), other case (*file) name of the file

resource.description: Resource is always a String - meaning depends on the type, for example if that is 'external', then resource is a class name

responseFormatterSetInvokerDefinition.description: Object that holds a response formatter set invoker

responseFormatterSetArrayDefinition.description: Describes the formatter method(s) applied on the specific response

responseDescriptorDefinition.description: Describes what answer should be sent back, and in case a template is used, what method should be used to make it up-to-date

delay.description: Optional, default value is 0, delay of the response in seconds, 0 means no delay

code.description: Optional, response code, default value is 200 (here E500 and others can be specified)

responseFormatterSetsDefinition.description: An array of response formatter sets

validityValue.description: When usage is 'timeout', after a timeout (specified in minutes in validityValue), the node will be disabled

class.description: The name of the interceptor class, will be used to load the class itself

validityValue.description: When usage is 'timeout', after a timeout (specified in minutes in validityValue), the node will be disabled
